doc: Hermite smoothstep 3k^2 - 2k^3 with k = clip((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1), a = -1.6 and b = 0 (the cumulus-density window of compose), float64 x from -3 to 3: below a (0), exactly on a and b, inside, above b (1). Float64 closed form: rtol 1e-9. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 3.3e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 7e4x that spread.
